text: The Budget Subcommittee for City Hall, Scarborough Civic Centre and North York Civic Centre Consultation will hear public presentations on the 2018 Capital and Operating Budgets at Scarborough Civic Centre, January 8, 2018 at 6:00 p.m. At its meeting on November 27, 2017, the Budget Committee established two subcommittees to hear the public deputations on the 2018 Capital and Operating Budgets at Scarborough, North York, Etobicoke, North York and York Civic Centres and City Hall, and made appointments to the Subcommittees as follows: 2018 Budget Public Deputation Meetings LOCATION DATE SESSIONS Scarborough Civic Centre January 8, 2018 Session 1 – 3:00 p.m. Session 2 – 6:00 p.m. Etobicoke Civic Centre January 8, 2018 Session 1 – 3:00 p.m. Session 2 – 6:00 p.m. North York Civic Centre January 9, 2018 Session 1 – 3:00 p.m. Session 2 – 6:00 p.m. York Civic Centre January 9, 2018 Session 1 –…

The Budget Subcommittee for City Hall, Scarborough Civic Centre, and North York Civic Centre Consultations received for information the public presentations and the communications submitted by members of the public.
